capabilities: Build a homepage layout with drag-and-drop, 2D resize and up to 100 blocks
Add widget blocks such as clock, quotes, image gallery, pomodoro timer and vault search
Record voice notes and transcribe them via OpenAI Whisper or Google Gemini
Style cards with accent colors, gradients, blur, borders and CSS variable overrides
Configure startup and open behavior for the homepage tab on desktop and mobile
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. The Voice Notes block uploads recorded audio to third-party transcription services; the plugin asks for per-provider consent, encrypts API keys at rest on the device, and strips keys from exported layouts. Voice recording is unavailable on platforms without MediaRecorder/navigator.mediaDevices.
problem: Obsidian opens on a note or file list and offers no customizable start page that gathers greetings, links, searches and widgets in one dashboard view.
